contractFactsFromSource.depositFlow: safeTransferFrom deposit token, apply protocolFeeBps, supply amountAfterFee to Aave v3 Pool (Optimism 0x794a61358D6845594F94dc1DB02A252b5b4814aD), mint JPY at Chainlink deposit-token/USD and JPY/USD rates
contractFactsFromSource.redemptionFlow: requestWithdrawal burns JPYT, converts at average rate totalMintedJpy/totalDepositToken (the documented Lock-In Exchange Rate), withdraws from Aave into the contract; executeWithdrawal pays out after cooldownBlocks; no operator approval gate
contractFactsFromSource.operatorPowers: OPERATOR_ROLE sets price feeds, cooldownBlocks, protocolFeeBps, and can withdraw collected fees (withdrawFeeAmount) and the Aave yield surplus (withdrawAaveProfit); UPGRADER_ROLE controls UUPS upgrades
contractFactsFromSource.aaveProfitFunction: getCurrentAaveProfit() = aToken balanceOf(proxy) - totalDepositToken; withdrawable by OPERATOR at any time, so the surplus is not a committed backstop

searchLog.backstop: Searched docs.dephaser.com (all 14 pages via llms.txt), the Terms of Service, contract source, and both audit PDFs for any protocol surplus, insurance fund, or committed backstop. Found only: (a) emergent Aave yield surplus (measured: 4,242.05 USDT + 831.67 USDC at the pinned blocks), operator-claimable via withdrawAaveProfit and not published or committed as a backstop; (b) Aave's own safety mechanisms, which protect Aave lenders, not JPYT holders. No committed backstop exists; component left uncurated.
searchLog.shutdownAndBadDebt: Searched the same corpus for wind-down/shutdown procedures and shortfall handling. Found: permissionless contract-level two-step redemption (source + on-chain params verified; no operator gate), pro-rata loss sharing via the average-rate redemption pool, and Terms of Service (effective 2024-09-12) Termination clause: 'any outstanding obligations related to locked-in positions will remain enforceable'. No formal wind-down runbook and no unconditional recapitalization commitment exists; graded limited on the lusd/bold mainline (documented mechanics without unconditional recapitalization).
searchLog.attestations: No reserve attestation or proof-of-reserves page exists for DePhaser (docs, website, GitHub checked); the on-chain reads above are the first pinned verification of the 1:1 backing.
